abstract: A 30-year-old white female was diagnosed with gestational trophoblastic disease in 1981. Despite an original World Health Organization score of 4 and initial aggressive combination chemotherapy, she was treated over a 9-year period with multiple chemotherapy agents and had undergone several operative procedures to remove metastatic lesions for persistent disease. Long-term remission has now been obtained after four courses of etoposide, ifosfamide, and cisplatin.
abstract_ja: 1981年に妊娠性絨毛性疾患と診断された30歳の白人女性がいる。当初のWHOスコアは4であり、初期の積極的な多剤併用化学療法にもかかわらず、9年間にわたり複数の化学療法薬で治療を受け、持続性病変に対して転移病変を切除する手術を数回受けた。エトポシド、イホスファミド、シスプラチンの4コース投与後に長期寛解が得られた。
